rules: Endurance is multi-dimensional; there is no single universal fuel bar.
The limiting resource depends on mission, ship class/configuration, damage, crew and era.
A ship may have propulsion endurance but lack medical, ordnance or repair endurance for a proposed mission.
Long-range mission feasibility must preserve required return/emergency reserve unless command deliberately accepts the risk.
Crew fatigue and maintenance backlog can limit practical endurance even when consumables remain.
